The sparrow report publishes the merge explicitly at each canyon. Each collapsed cluster gets one shale weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. A farm of 4501 identities would post 918 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
